# Configuration and State Management

This layer is responsible for applying changes to code, managing state, and handling configuration inputs.

## Overview

This layer includes modules that support different aspects of the software project, including parsing, analyzing, and applying changes to code.

## Responsibilities

- **State Management:** `apply.js`, `changes.js`, `config.js`, `folders.js`, `git.js`, `importance.js`, `links.js`, `main.js`, `process.js`, `readme.js`, `report.js`, `state.js`, `structure.js`

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/apply.js`](../src/apply.js) | Applies the results of a run and merges the state. | `applyRun` |

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `BASE_BRANCH`, `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, `GITHUB_REF_NAME`, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `PUSH`.
- Action inputs: `backlog-batch-size`, `comment-level`, `context-tokens`, `docs-dir`, `docs-model`, `exclude`, `existing-code`, `extensions`, `job-timeout-minutes`, `model`, `path`, `time-budget-minutes`.
